zh:
· 教学中心：从第一份字幕开始，按章节练习编辑、术语、兔白和导出。
· 兔白看图与任务工具：按权限查看应用窗口和授权文件夹，分步处理问题。
· 术语导入与冲突筛选：预览文件和AI整理结果后写入，集中查看冲突项。
· AI失败补救：同一服务与模型提高一级思考再试一轮，失败仍保留回退结果。
· 我的改动与操作优化：自定义界面可保留和恢复，校对与术语控件更紧凑。
en: Tutorial center with chapter-based practice. Bunny can inspect the app window with permission and use task tools and authorized folders. Preview glossary imports and AI cleanup, then filter conflicting entries. Bounded AI rescue retries use the same service and model at a higher thinking level while preserving fallback results. Keep and restore interface customizations, with more compact proofreading and glossary controls.
